source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Βασιανός του Ούγκλιχ»

attestations.note: The day's line gives him the epithet «του Ούγκλιχ» and his page a village, a district, an age and a year. The corpus's existing `bassian-the-venerable` is a bare Romanian line on 10 October with no place and no year; this man is the specified one and the day is not the same, but the two names fold together and a reader should know it.
